Description: Sithil-Horak is Shapur II’s spouse and the mother of Yubeh, Zruanduxt and Shapur III. Within the royal household she is concerned first with how her family treats one another and whether court promises expose them to danger. Polite praise of the dynasty does not convince her that a courtier will accept responsibility for its members. She wants her children to find suitable roles without competing destructively for their father’s approval. Shapur III’s ambitions give her both hope and concern that followers may press him further than he intends. She prefers to clarify disagreements privately before household frustration becomes a public factional position. She will care for those close to her in difficulty without claiming that personal influence gives her control over the kingdom.
